first.rationale: Activation messaging (memory_91) showed direct impact on week-one engagement and first meaningful action. Current state shows activation down 6% QoQ and onboarding completion down 4% QoQ. While simplification (memory_31) worked well for SMB signup, we need to address the engagement cliff post-signup. Memory_91 is proven in-product lever that doesn't require structural changes and complements onboarding (memory_86). Promotional pricing (memory_73) would be reactive to competitor pressure rather than addressing our organic engagement decline, and memory_73's pooled cohorts create analytical uncertainty. Enterprise sales assist (memory_44) targets a different motion. Activation messaging is highest-conviction lever for recovering the 6% engagement drop with lowest execution risk and no revenue dilution. Verifying memory_31 and memory_91 to confirm field reduction durability and messaging specifics before deployment.
